title: KARBALA ME HUA LAKHTE DIL E SHABBAR TUKDE
body:
Karbala me hua lakhte Dil e Shabbar Tukde
Ran se Qasim ke utha laaye hain Sarwar Tukde
Pohnche maidaan me Qasim ki sada sun kar jab
Dekha Shabbir ne Bhai ka hai Dilbar tukde
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar jhukaye huwe Rote hain Hussain Ibne Ali
Apne Bhai ki nishaani ke utha kar tukde
Hai ye Qasim ka Janaaza ke jigar Shabbar ka
Ran se Shabbir utha Laay Bahattar tukde
<<DIVIDER>>
Maadar e Hazrat e Qasim se ye Kehte hain Hussain
Aap ke Laal ke laaye hain utha kar tukde
Wagea Hazrat e Qasim ki Shahadat ka Rasheed
Sun ke hota hai har ek ka dil e muztar tukde
author: Rasheed Shaheedi
